enrichment.headline: Adds $15,902 to Digital Design's alarm maintenance during the PG&E shutdown for the solar project
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $15,902 for Digital Design Communications to maintain fire and intrusion alarm systems during the PG&E power shutdown for the Solar Initiative Group I Project. After power is restored, the systems will be rebooted to their current conditions. It raises the spending limit from $102,786 to $118,688 and extends the end date to August 30, 2024, an added 61 days.
